svg.text: GNSS AFE (GPS L1 C/A + Galileo E1) for GF180MCU - top level, 15 pins, on-chip NC-LNA, SPI control
Supply pins: VDD, VDDV, VSS (drawn as supply symbols at each device pin; ground symbol = VSS)
Devices: GF180MCU PDK (nfet_03v3 / pfet_03v3 / ppolyf_u_1k / cap_mim_2f0fF); W, L in metres (u = um); bulk drawn to source where tied, otherwise tagged.
